source.text:
Let's talk about a lawnmower. Bought one the other day. Effective tool?

Nope! Now it's "automation". Why ?

Using a lawnmower on your lawn doesn't give you control over the grass it cuts! It just cuts willy nilly wherever you point it, you can't get into the pebbles of your garden bed and forget that curvy edge work you had put in last month. And that's not even the worst. A lawnmower denies you the chance to learn how different breeds of grass make up your lawn or how each breed responds to a scythe. You never get to spend achingly long stretches admiring how grass glints differently in the sun at different times of the day, nor how it smells when cut - you'll mostly smell two stroke. A lawnmower uses insane amounts of oil and gas compared to the simple silent pleasure of walking around swinging a scythe. Being done with your lawn after a short while denies you a backbreaking day in the sun and you might even avoid a sunburn. Besides when you're done mowing your lawn what are you gonna do with all the time you got back! Read a book!?

Lawnmowers are a scam!
